name: Tipo de Guía de Remisión
source: The discriminator perunio-facturador uses to pick a GRE builder, from internal/model/despatch.go:10-12. Two of the three are Cat.01 códigos; 'EV' is not — it is a Perunio-internal marker meaning 'guía por eventos', and the XML it produces still carries 09 or 31 in cbc:DespatchAdviceTypeCode. That is why it is `internal` with props.wireEquivalent, and why this is its own file rather than three más entries in cat01.json.
